analysis.reason: 3일 연속 관망 판정 유지. RSI 52.0으로 중립 구간 안착, MACD 히스토그램 개선세 둔화. 5일 평균 거래량 대비 0.16배로 거래량 부재. 20일 저가 $65.08 대비 5일 저가 $70.55로 Higher Low 패턴 미형성. 52주 위치 14.5%로 여전히 낮은 수준.
analysis.reasonEn: 3-day consecutive wait-and-see stance maintained. RSI at 52.0 settles in neutral zone, MACD histogram improvement slowing. Volume ratio at 0.16x of 5-day average indicates low activity. No Higher Low pattern formed from 5-day low of $70.55 compared to 20-day low of $65.08. 52-week position at 14.5% remains low.

[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (50.3→52.0) — 중립 구간 지속, 과매도 탈출 후 횡보
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (0.5259→0.7418) — 개선세 둔화, 강세 전환 신호 미약
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 $71.96) — 중단 부근 횡보, 밴드폭 12.93%로 축소
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($70.86) — 피벗 S1($67.50) 및 20일 저가($65.08) 기반
· 스윙 저항선 ($77.30) — 5일 고가($75.30) 상회 시 접근

[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.16배) — 무기력한 움직임, 신뢰도 하락
· 현 구간 진단 — 축적 구간, 방향성 부재로 인한 관망 조건
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($74.03) vs SMA5($73.16)/SMA20($71.96)/SMA50($76.21) — Short-term bullish bias, below mid-term
· Significantly below SMA100($84.95)/SMA200($90.60) — Long-term trend weak
· 52-week position (14.5%) — Approaching historical low range
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (50.3→52.0) — Neutral zone sustained, sideways after exiting oversold
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (0.5259→0.7418) — Slowing improvement, weak bullish reversal signal
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid $71.96) — Sideways near mid-band, 12.93% band width narrowing
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($70.86) — Based on Pivot S1($67.50) and 20-day low($65.08)
· Swing Resistance ($77.30) — Approaching upon breaking 5-day high($75.30)
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern — Potential early Higher Low pattern with 5-day low($70.55) > 20-day low($65.08), forming Lower High pattern with 5-day high($75.30) < 20-day high($75.70)
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.16x) — Lethargic movement, low confidence
· Current Phase Diagnosis — Accumulation phase, conditions for observation due to lack of direction
analysis.patternNote: 5일 저가 $70.55가 20일 저가 $65.08보다 높아 Higher Low 패턴 형성 가능성, 5일 고가 $75.30이 20일 고가 $75.70보다 낮아 Lower High 패턴 형성 중. 방향성 부재로 인한 횡보 구간 지속.
analysis.patternNoteEn: Potential Higher Low pattern formation as 5-day low $70.55 exceeds 20-day low $65.08, while a Lower High pattern is forming with 5-day high $75.30 below 20-day high $75.70. Sideways consolidation continues due to lack of directional momentum.
